resources.string: Set up power strip
Back

For a new strip only. Choose LAN or Direct VPS, enter its setup network and your router Wi-Fi. Temporarily join TONLY_TAP/ONLY_TAP, write the settings, then reconnect to Internet. Existing working strips need no setup. Wi-Fi setup does not grant device ownership or control.
Strip setup network (TONLY_TAP_…)
Router Wi-Fi name
Router Wi-Fi password
Existing local Controller IPv4
Prepare server address automatically
I am setting up a new strip and understand this changes its network settings.
Open Wi-Fi settings / return to Internet
Connect to setup network and configure
Configure after joining setup Wi-Fi manually
Returned to Internet — check my devices
Prepare the server address while Internet is connected, before joining setup Wi-Fi.
Local route: keep your existing Controller address. This wizard does not change saved Controller preferences.
Preparing server address…
Could not prepare server address. Reconnect to Internet and retry. Nothing was written to the strip.
Server address ready. You can now join the setup network.
Check setup network, router Wi-Fi, Controller address and the new-strip confirmation. Prepare the server address before disconnecting Internet.
The strip acknowledged network settings. Reconnect to Internet, then check your personal account. This does not confirm VPS connection or grant control.
The strip acknowledged network settings. Return to your local network and verify connection in LAN/ZeroTier.
This strip is not visible in your account. Ask administration to approve and assign it. Network setup grants no permissions.
Your assigned strip is connected to the server. Account and outlet permissions apply.
The strip is assigned to your account but has not connected to the server yet.
